title: Research: two-repeat partitioned 8q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Names a **third** dirt-legal readout alphabet at `Q=8` beyond same-walk / dirty-shadow / partitioned dual / one-repeat: **two-repeat** (excess-2) layers on partitioned independent duals. Answers the remaining priced-alphabet handoff after [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) / [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858): does any further alphabet undercut tariff `436` at eight queries?

| Dual schedule | Valid | Covering pairs | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Two-repeat `(2,6)` | 26970 | **0** | **no** |
| Two-repeat `(3,5)` | 465 | **0** | **no** |
| Two-repeat `(4,4)` | 0 | **0** | **no** |

Exact covering census is empty on every shape (structural span/sumset bounds), so there is no covering `R` and no undercut of the six-query endpoint. Length-4 `{d:3}` never restores.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) / [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) / [#2846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2846) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q/`.
Tip: `c4581aaf852dc0ec49f41d6404e484c7a43dcd9f`.

Exact: covering **0** on `(2,6)`/`(3,5)`/`(4,4)`; no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_TWOREPEAT_8Q_OBSTRUCTION covering_26=0 covering_35=0 covering_44=0 ... no_undercut_436 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_TWOREPEAT_8Q covering_26=0 covering_35=0 ... no_undercut_436 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_TWOREPEAT_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-tworepeat-8q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) (one-repeat `(3,5)`/`(4,4)`), [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851), [#2840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2840), [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677). Freestanding two-repeat alphabet; no competing open PR at refresh.
